# Observation Method

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ObservationMethod`](gmeow-ObservationMethod.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ObservationMethod>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)

The method or protocol by which an observation was made — a value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). Generalizes [`gmeow:DatingMethod`](gmeow-DatingMethod.md) (temporal module) and subsumes sensor types, survey protocols, laboratory techniques, archaeological procedures, and standpoint assertion methods. A method is constitutive of the observation: changing the method changes the observation's identity (it is a different act).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ObservationMethod`](gmeow-ObservationMethod.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
